description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world-class research.  We empower exceptional talent in mathematics, physics, and computer science to explore scientific boundaries, push beyond them, and apply cutting-edge research to global financial markets.  Our culture is unique.  Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive drive.  We believe in winning together and unlocking individual talent through collaboration and mutual respect.  At Jump, our research produces more than superior risk-adjusted returns.  We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund startups across industries, and partner with leading research organizations and universities to solve difficult problems.

 One of Jump's established quantitative trading teams is seeking a Trading Production Engineer to provide primary production coverage during U.S. trading hours and improve the reliability of its day-to-day operations.  Supporting trading across global markets, this engineer will monitor critical workflows, respond to production issues, and work closely with quantitative researchers and software engineers.

 This is an operations-first engineering role.  It requires practical systems and coding skills to investigate problems, automate routine work, and implement safe, well-scoped fixes.  More complex software changes will be developed in partnership with the team's engineers.

 What you’ll do 

 
 After onboarding, serve as the primary operational point of contact during U.S. trading hours for the team's global production environment

 Monitor end-to-end trading workflows, including market connectivity, data availability and quality, and scheduled model and optimization processes

 Respond to alerts, failed jobs, and degraded systems; resolve routine and moderately complex issues independently and partner with developers on deeper problems

 Develop a broad understanding of the team's systems, dependencies, and trading workflows

 Maintain and improve monitoring, alerting, documentation, and support processes; automate repetitive work and implement safe, well-scoped code or configuration changes

 Coordinate regional handoffs and communicate clearly with quantitative researchers, engineers, and middle-office teams

 Other duties as assigned or needed

 
 Skills you’ll need 

 
 At least 5+ years of experience in production engineering, trade support, systems operations, or a related function; electronic trading experience is preferred but not required

 Working proficiency with Python, Linux, and shell scripting, including comfort reading and debugging existing code and making tested, well-scoped changes

 Familiarity with monitoring, alerting, automation, data pipelines, or scheduled production workflows

 A systematic, calm approach to troubleshooting and sound judgment about when to act independently or involve other engineers

 Strong written and verbal communication skills and a collaborative, self-directed working style

 A genuine interest in production ownership, reliability, and operational improvement

 Reliable and predictable availability

 Benefits 

 
 Discretionary bonus eligibility 

 Medical, dental, and vision insurance 

 HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care options 

 Employer Paid Group Term Life and AD&D Insurance 

 Voluntary Life & AD&D insurance 

 Paid vacation plus paid holidays 

 Retirement plan with employer match 

 Paid parental leave 

 Wellness Programs 

 

 
 Annual Base Salary Range 
 $200,000 — $250,000 USD
